ValidationRule.description: Prevent Same Ownership of Manual and QA Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_QA_Case', NOT(ISBLANK( ParentId )), ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), OwnerId = Parent.OwnerId, $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The owner cannot be the same as the Parent Case.
